sources.title: 上海市第三批优秀历史建筑名单
愚园路1320弄花园住宅
sources.author: 上海市长宁区规划和自然资源局
sources.notes: The district says four English-style detached garden houses, built 1925, plot 11,500 square metres and total floor area approximately 3,040 square metres. Its unnumbered picture shows the same four dormers, five piers and three chimneys with glazing between the balcony piers and a central emblem. The district photo is used only for comparison.

sources.title: 愚园路1320弄新华村
sources.author: 高参88

individual_photo_order.14: 11号楼 Four equal bays, three chimneys, shallow dormers and central emblem.
individual_photo_order.15: 12号楼 Single gable front, small upper window, house number visible.
individual_photo_order.16: 14号楼 Four dormers with flanking towers rising above the main roof.
individual_photo_order.17: 15号楼 Asymmetric turret and short recessed veranda.

sources.notes: The unnumbered photo 6 shows four plinth slit windows, stone pierced sloping cheeks and a lower gallery, and photo 11 shows the same four dormers open. In photo 5 a metal stair railing is present. The four numbered images are in two side-by-side pairs followed by their two captions in reading order. Site photographs are reference only.
